selector.description: A CSS selector that finds the element on its screen (from the screen's [data-step] section, or an id).

label.description: What the element says or is (its label, text or tag), as the reviewer saw it.

html.description: The element's HTML when it was picked (cut at 1500 characters).

x.description: Where the element was on the page, in CSS pixels (its top-right corner): the bubble's spot when the selector no longer finds it.

w.description: The element's width when picked, CSS pixels.

h.description: The element's height when picked, CSS pixels.
